requirements: R1: An exam attempt starts in the NotStarted state before the exam window opens.
R2: When the student authenticates within the scheduled exam window while in NotStarted, the system moves to Ready.
R3: When the student starts the exam while in Ready, the system locks the attempt and moves to InProgress.
R4: When the student submits answers voluntarily while in InProgress, the system records the submission and moves to Submitted.
R5: When the exam timer expires while in InProgress, the system auto-submits the current answers and moves to Submitted.
R6: When the student attempts to start before the published exam window while in NotStarted, the system must deny start and remain in NotStarted.
R7: When the student attempts to start after the allowed late-start grace period while in NotStarted, the system marks the attempt as Missed and remains terminal in Missed.
R8: When a proctor-approved accommodation is applied before start while in Ready, the system stores the extended time allowance and remains in Ready.
R9: When a prohibited browser tab switch is detected while in InProgress and the violation count is below the maximum, the system records a warning and remains in InProgress.
R10: When the maximum allowed tab-switch violations is reached while in InProgress, the system terminates the attempt and moves to Terminated.
R11: When the attempt is Terminated, the system auto-submits collected answers with a violation flag and moves to Submitted.
R12: The system must not accept manual submission unless the attempt is in the InProgress state.
R13: Once the attempt reaches Submitted or Missed, the system must not allow restart or return to InProgress.
